prog='''def extract(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                v=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
                out.append({'v':v,'cells':cells,'r0':min(rs),'c0':min(cs),'h':max(rs)-min(rs)+1,'w':max(cs)-min(cs)+1,'n':len(cells)})
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=grid; h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); sh=extract(g)
    sh.sort(key=lambda s:(-s['n'], -s['r0'], -s['c0']))
    k=(len(sh)+1)//2
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    placed=[]
    def collides(r0,c0,hh,ww):
        return any(not(r0+hh<=pr or pr+ph<=r0 or c0+ww<=pc or pc+pw<=c0) for pr,pc,ph,pw in placed)
    for group,down in ((sh[:k],True),(sh[k:],False)):
        for s in sorted(group,key=lambda s:(s['n'],s['r0'],s['c0'])):
            if down:
                r=0
                while collides(r,s['c0'],s['h'],s['w']): r+=1
            else:
                r=h-s['h']
                while collides(r,s['c0'],s['h'],s['w']): r-=1
            placed.append((r,s['c0'],s['h'],s['w']))
            for a,b in s['cells']: out[a-s['r0']+r][b]=s['v']
    return out
'''
